title: FX2 1.01: rear screen (3:2 panel) shows the open-gate live view at 3:2 with the focus frames (the A7 IV's lcdfill_v2: fit word and the frame widgets' 16:9 entries), and the built-in De-Squeeze Display ratios set for a 3:2 picture (1.3x 1.95:1, 2.0x the whole frame at 3:1 with the centre 4:3 crop off; 1.65x 2.467:1, 1.8x 2.7:1)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin 1.01 (ILME-FX2), its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the words are in the file, the change is made in RAM only
ported_from: lcdfill_v2 (A7 IV 6.02; works on that camera, F966/F969: the same seven words at the FX2's addresses, its fit function and frame tables byte-identical) + the FX3 kit's de-squeeze part (lcd32dsq_fx3_v1), redone on the FX2's own calculator, crop and device-rectangle code

summary.panel: rear LCD, 3:2 (720 x 480, panel code 1 from type byte 3)
summary.picture: 16:9 live view (aspect code 2) holding the whole 3:2 sensor area

desqueeze.code 2 (1.5x, not in the menu): its 16:9 case uses code 5's words: 3:1 while applied

goes_with: the FX2 open-gate state (A7 IV form: ogsq/outsz/ogfile steps of fx2_101)

while_applied: every 16:9 picture on the rear screen fills the 3:2 panel and the de-squeeze ratios are those of a 3:2 picture (other movie formats look wrong there). Codes 4 and 5's ratios are the calculator's only ratio for every picture shape and their crop is off for every shape. The EVF (4:3) shows the squeezed 16:9 picture with de-squeeze off, as on the A7 IV; with de-squeeze on it uses the same new ratios. HDMI's own layout path (0x1fa728) and the device command's factor bytes (0x1fad38) are unchanged
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on an FX2
the FX2's rear panel type byte 0x19d98cc (expected 3 = 3:2 from Sony's 1,036,800 dots; a dump should read it)
that the frame widgets use row 1 on the FX2's rear panel (as on the A7 IV; the row comes from the widget object at run time)
what the output-device rectangle of 0x7214b6 is used for (inferred: the picture's place on the output for codes 4/5)
whether the focus frames are drawn while de-squeeze is on (stock behaves the same either way)
